> 第3章 炼丹（第1页）
门外忽然有人在叫自己，听着脚步声在慢慢向自己屋内靠近。李天知道是谁，那熟悉的声音——林耀”。
林耀，外门弟子，自己的师兄。比自己年长两岁，天赋一般，炼体六重境界。和自己关系很好，对自己照顾有加。甚至自己每个月宗门给的炼体丹都分一半给自己。也总是护着自己。
“小天，我听说田萧那帮王八蛋又来欺负你了是不是。”林耀看着房内的李天，开口道。
“嗯。”李天看着关心自己的林耀，只是简单的回答了一个字。
这十年来，林耀也看的明白，从外门榜首，跌落至大杂院。要不是李天心性坚强，早已离开这元神宗了。
“小天，这是这个月修炼资源，我的给你一半，加上你的，我信你总有一天会再次恢复的。”林耀边说边递过来丹药。
看着递过来的丹药，李天心里很是感动。他回答道：“不用了林师兄，王长老给我送来了一些，你看我不是好好的吗？李天拒绝道。”
看着好好的李天，林耀也不再推辞。收起了丹药，自己也的确需要它。再过两个月宗门外门大比，晋升内院。你有什么事一定要和师兄说，那我先走了。”
看着消失在门外的林耀，李天也随之外出。两个月后就是宗门大比了，自己一定要提高实力才能报仇。
李天独自一个人悄悄地去了青阳山脉。他知道自己必须实践自己的实力、找些药材炼丹、提升自己的实力。
李天知道青阳山脉外围都是一些一阶到六阶的妖兽、内围则有更强大的妖兽如化凡境大妖、天神境巅峰的妖兽都有。所以李天小心翼翼地行走着、不让自己遇到这种大妖、不然就成了妖兽口中的食物了。
外围对于李天来说历练微乎其微、他一路走一路斩杀挡住他的那些妖兽、收获了很多妖核、精血和尸体也全部被他装进自己的储物袋里。其中他也采集了很多炼丹药材、光炼体丹药材如果炼出来至少能换来上百金币、这也是一笔不小的收获了。
在靠近内围边缘的时候、李天觉得可以提升自己的实力了、至少有自保的能力了。当即找了个无人的山洞开始炼丹。
根据自己得到的炼丹书、李天拿出星魂草、妖兽精血、姚核、血源花。以灵力化为凡火、开始炼制。李天第一次炼丹也是小心翼翼的操作着。一会功夫药物全部剥离炼出药性、就在熔丹的时候——砰、丹药全部损毁。还好鼎很好、不然鼎都炸没了。李天再次尝试炼丹、这次没过多久炼制出来的竟然是极品练体丹、整整八枚丹药。喜出望外这让李天非常开心。
李天不是不知道炼丹有多难、一般炼丹基本五枚都是特等。这种极品已经称之为神乎其神了。第二炉都这么好、还超出预期让他感到非常惊喜。
随后李天也不再犹豫、一个小时两个小时地连续炼制。把所有炼体丹材料全部炼成了丹药。足足二十瓶练体丹和血脉丹。这达到了五千金币的价值了、而且还都是极品。不知道拿到天华商行会值多少钱呢？

> Chapter 3 Alchemy (Page 1)
Suddenly someone called him outside the door, and he heard footsteps slowly approaching his house. Li Tian knows who it is, that familiar voice - Lin Yao."
Lin Yao, an outer disciple and his senior brother. He is two years older than himself, has average talent, and is at the sixth level of body refining. He has a good relationship with himself and takes good care of himself. He even gives himself half of the body refining pills given by his sect every month. He always protects himself.
"Xiaotian, I heard that those bastards from Tian Xiao are here to bully you again, right? Lin Yao looked at Li Tian in the room and said.
"Hmm. "Li Tian looked at Lin Yao who cared about him and simply answered with one word.
In the past ten years, Lin Yao has also seen clearly that he has fallen from the top of the outer sect to the main courtyard. If Li Tian hadn't been strong-minded, he would have left the Yuanshen Sect long ago.
"Xiaotian, these are the training resources for this month. I will give you half of mine, plus yours. I believe you will recover again one day. Lin Yao said as he handed over the elixir.
Looking at the elixir handed over, Li Tian was very moved. He replied: "No need, Senior Brother Lin, Elder Wang sent me some, don't you think I'm doing well? Li Tian refused. "
Seeing Li Tian doing well, Lin Yao no longer refused. He put away the elixir, he really needed it. In two months' time, there will be a competition between the outer sects of the sect and he will be promoted to the inner court. If you have anything to do, you must tell your senior brother, then I'll leave first. "
Seeing Lin Yao disappearing outside the door, Li Tian also walked out. There will be a sect competition in two months, and he must improve his strength to take revenge.
Li Tian quietly went to the Qingyang Mountains alone. He knew that he had to practice his strength, find some medicinal materials to make elixirs, and improve his strength.
Li Tian knew that the outer perimeter of the Qingyang Mountain Range was filled with first- to sixth-level monsters, while the inner circle contained more powerful monsters, such as the great monsters in the Mortal Realm and monsters at the peak of the Heavenly God Realm. So Li Tian walked carefully to prevent himself from encountering such a big monster, otherwise he would become food in the mouth of the monster.
Li Tian had very little experience in the periphery. He went all the way to kill the monsters that blocked him, and harvested a lot of monster cores, blood essence, and corpses, which he put into his storage bag. Among them, he also collected a lot of medicinal materials for alchemy and light body elixir. If he can refine them, he can get at least hundreds of gold coins, which is also a big gain.
When he was nearing the edge of the inner circle, Li Tian felt that he could improve his strength and at least have the ability to protect himself. He immediately found a deserted cave and started making elixirs.
Based on the alchemy book he obtained, Li Tian took out the Star Soul Grass, Monster Blood Essence, Yao Core, and Blood Source Flower. Use spiritual power to turn it into ordinary fire and start refining it. Li Tian also operated carefully when he made alchemy for the first time. After a while, all the medicine was peeled off and the medicinal properties were extracted. Just when the elixir was being melted - bang, all the elixir was destroyed. Fortunately, the tripod is very good, otherwise the tripod would have exploded. Li Tian tried to refine elixirs again, and this time what he refined soon turned out to be the best body-training elixir, a total of eight elixirs. Overjoyed, this made Li Tian very happy.
It's not like Li Tian didn't know how difficult it is to make alchemy. Generally, the five pills he makes are all special. This kind of top quality has been called miraculous. He was very surprised that the second batch was so good and exceeded his expectations.
Then Li Tian no longer hesitated and continued to refine for an hour or two. Refined all the body refining elixir materials into elixirs. A total of twenty bottles of body training pills and bloodline pills. This has reached the value of five thousand gold coins, and they are all top quality. I wonder how much it would be worth to get Tianhua Commercial Guild?
